HPC & GPU Workstation Deployment: VRAM Sizing, Containers, and Long-Transcript Chunking

Source: vignettes/hpc-gpu-deployment.Rmd
hpc-gpu-deployment.Rmd

Overview

Deploying open-weights LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral) on departmental GPU workstations or university HPC Slurm nodes introduces practical engineering challenges that go beyond calling a local HTTP port:

  • GPU Out-of-Memory (OOM) Failures: Selecting a quantization level and context window that exceeds available VRAM.
  • Strict Air-Gapping: Ensuring Docker and Apptainer containers cannot make outbound network calls, download telemetry, or escape mounted model directories via symlinks.
  • Long Qualitative Transcripts: Therapy transcripts and semi-structured interviews frequently exceed 4,096–8,192 tokens and require deterministic overlapping chunking prior to extraction.
  • Walltime Preemption & Schema Drift: Resuming 50,000-row batches cleanly after Slurm preemption while blocking accidental schema or prompt mismatches.
library(airgapllm)

1. Right-Sizing Workstation & HPC GPUs (estimate_vram_requirements())

Estimate total GPU memory (model weights + KV cache + runtime overhead) across quantizations and context windows before requesting GPU allocations:

# 8B model in Q4_K_M with 8k context for a single lab workstation GPU
vram_8b <- estimate_vram_requirements(
  params_b = 8,
  quantization = "Q4_K_M",
  context_length = 8192L,
  batch_size = 2L
)
vram_8b
#> <airgap_vram_estimate>
#>   Model:            8B parameters (Q4_K_M, 32 layers)
#>   Context / Batch:  8192 tokens x 2 (KV: FP16)
#>   Weights VRAM:     4.47 GB
#>   KV-Cache VRAM:    2.00 GB
#>   Runtime Overhead: 1.35 GB
#>   Total Estimated:  7.82 GB
#>   Recommended Tier: 8 GB (Workstation RTX 4060 / 16 GB Unified)

# Compare 70B Q4_K_M vs 14B Q8_0 for an HPC A100-80GB / L40S node
estimate_vram_requirements(14, quantization = "Q8_0", context_length = 8192L, batch_size = 4L)
#> <airgap_vram_estimate>
#>   Model:            14B parameters (Q8_0, 40 layers)
#>   Context / Batch:  8192 tokens x 4 (KV: FP16)
#>   Weights VRAM:     13.95 GB
#>   KV-Cache VRAM:    5.00 GB
#>   Runtime Overhead: 1.65 GB
#>   Total Estimated:  20.60 GB
#>   Recommended Tier: 24 GB (RTX 3090/4090 / A10G / L4)
estimate_vram_requirements(70, quantization = "Q4_K_M", context_length = 8192L, batch_size = 2L)
#> <airgap_vram_estimate>
#>   Model:            70B parameters (Q4_K_M, 80 layers)
#>   Context / Batch:  8192 tokens x 2 (KV: FP16)
#>   Weights VRAM:     39.12 GB
#>   KV-Cache VRAM:    5.00 GB
#>   Runtime Overhead: 1.35 GB
#>   Total Estimated:  45.47 GB
#>   Recommended Tier: 48 GB (L40S / A6000)

Inspect GPU tier headroom directly from $fits_tiers:

vram_8b$fits_tiers
#> # A tibble: 7 × 4
#>   gpu_tier                                    vram_gb fits  headroom_gb
#>   <chr>                                         <dbl> <lgl>       <dbl>
#> 1 8 GB (Workstation RTX 4060 / 16 GB Unified)       8 TRUE         0.18
#> 2 16 GB (RTX 4080 / A4000 / V100-16GB)             16 TRUE         8.18
#> 3 24 GB (RTX 3090/4090 / A10G / L4)                24 TRUE        16.2 
#> 4 40 GB (A100-40GB)                                40 TRUE        32.2 
#> 5 48 GB (L40S / A6000)                             48 TRUE        40.2 
#> 6 80 GB (A100-80GB / H100-80GB)                    80 TRUE        72.2 
#> 7 160 GB (2x A100/H100 80GB)                      160 TRUE       152.

2. Hardened --network none Docker & HPC Apptainer Configurations

Pin both the container image digest (sha256:...) and local model weight digest (verify_model_digest()) to guarantee reproducibility and tamper resistance across nodes:

work_dir <- tempfile("airgap_hpc_vignette_")
dir.create(work_dir)
weights_file <- file.path(work_dir, "qwen2.5-14b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf")
writeBin(charToRaw("synthetic-local-gguf-weights-for-vignette"), weights_file)

# Verify streaming SHA-256 (blocks symlinks & path escapes by default)
w_ver <- verify_model_digest(weights_file, root_dir = work_dir)
w_ver
#> <airgap_digest_verification> [COMPUTED]
#>   Path:       /tmp/RtmpgzcQqJ/airgap_hpc_vignette_1baba880b22/qwen2.5-14b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf
#>   Size bytes: 41
#>   Actual:     sha256:3dd70bdd5679d2af58a4c576e94e76975aca7a687da3e5f0b6886880579b3915

spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "vllm",
  image = "vllm/vllm-openai",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("e", 64)),
  model_dir = work_dir,
  model_file = basename(weights_file),
  model_digest = w_ver$actual_digest,
  gpu = "nvidia",
  gpu_devices = "device=0",
  memory_limit = "48g",
  shm_size = "8g",
  user = "1000:1000"
)

# Emit Compose YAML (read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, offline telemetry flags)
cat(emit_docker_compose(spec))
#> # Generated by airgapllm 0.3.0
#> # Spec digest: sha256:c815442e3008ab69ee493dbc3f2dee02610c76d2377e97fbb400937606a11515
#> services:

#>     image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

#>       - ALL
#>     security_opt:
#>       - no-new-privileges:true

#>       - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m
#>       - /run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m
#>     volumes:
#>       - /tmp/RtmpgzcQqJ/airgap_hpc_vignette_1baba880b22:/models:ro
#>     environment:
#>       DO_NOT_TRACK: '1'
#>       HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE: '1'
#>       HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
#>       TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: '1'
#>     command:
#>       - --model
#>       - /models/qwen2.5-14b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf
#>       - --host
#>       - 127.0.0.1
#>       - --port
#>       - '8000'
#>       - --disable-log-requests
#>     restart: 'no'

Generate the companion HPC Apptainer .def recipe with --containall --no-home --net --network none --nv:

cat(emit_apptainer_def(spec))
#> # Generated by airgapllm 0.3.0
#> # Air-gapped HPC execution command:
#> #   apptainer build airgapllm-vllm.sif airgapllm.def
#> #   apptainer run --containall --no-home --net --network none --nv --bind '/tmp/RtmpgzcQqJ/airgap_hpc_vignette_1baba880b22:/models:ro' airgapllm-vllm.sif
#>

#> %environment
#>     export DO_NOT_TRACK='1'
#>     export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE='1'

Confirm container posture, weight integrity, endpoint loopback confinement, and absence of unbypassed outbound proxy variables before starting inference:

preflight_isolation_check(
  spec = spec,
  endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1",
  model_path = weights_file
)
#> <airgap_preflight> [PASS]

3. Deterministic Chunking for Long Clinical Transcripts

When transcripts exceed local context windows, split them deterministically along paragraph or sentence boundaries using chunk_clinical_texts() while retaining doc_id, chunk_id, and exact character offsets for downstream re-aggregation:

data("synthetic_notes", package = "airgapllm")
long_record <- synthetic_notes[synthetic_notes$note_id == "SYN_016", ]

chunks <- chunk_clinical_texts(
  data = long_record,
  text_col = "note_text",
  id_col = "note_id",
  max_chars = 340L,
  overlap_chars = 50L,
  split_on = "paragraph"
)
chunks[, c("doc_id", "chunk_id", "chunk_index", "n_chunks", "start_char", "end_char", "char_count")]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   doc_id  chunk_id          chunk_index n_chunks start_char end_char char_count
#>   <chr>   <chr>                   <int>    <int>      <int>    <int>      <int>
#> 1 SYN_016 SYN_016_chunk_001           1        3          1      251        251
#> 2 SYN_016 SYN_016_chunk_002           2        3        208      498        291
#> 3 SYN_016 SYN_016_chunk_003           3        3        452      715        264

Run airgap_extract() directly over chunks using id_col = "chunk_id" so every chunk is independently PII-redacted, schema-validated, and checkpointed:

chunk_schema <- extraction_schema(
  topic = schema_field("enum", values = c("sleep", "coping", "logistics", "other")),
  crisis_flag = schema_field("logical")
)

ck_file <- file.path(work_dir, "chunks_checkpoint.jsonl")
chunk_res <- airgap_extract(
  data = chunks,
  text_col = "chunk_text",
  schema = chunk_schema,
  runtime = runtime_mock(seed = 77L),
  id_col = "chunk_id",
  checkpoint_path = ck_file,
  container_spec = spec,
  model_path = weights_file
)

chunk_res[, c("chunk_id", "topic", "crisis_flag", ".status")]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   chunk_id          topic     crisis_flag .status
#>   <chr>             <chr>     <lgl>       <chr>  
#> 1 SYN_016_chunk_001 coping    FALSE       ok     
#> 2 SYN_016_chunk_002 logistics TRUE        ok     
#> 3 SYN_016_chunk_003 coping    FALSE       ok

4. Checkpoint Schema-Drift Guards & Offline Troubleshooting

If an analyst edits the extraction schema or prompt template mid-study and accidentally points airgap_extract() at an old checkpoint_path with resume = TRUE, airgapllm refuses to silently mix incompatible schemas:

modified_schema <- extraction_schema(
  topic = schema_field("enum", values = c("sleep", "coping", "logistics", "other")),
  severity = schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 5L)
)

tryCatch(
  airgap_extract(
    data = chunks,
    text_col = "chunk_text",
    schema = modified_schema,
    runtime = runtime_mock(seed = 77L),
    id_col = "chunk_id",
    checkpoint_path = ck_file,
    resume = TRUE
  ),
  airgap_checkpoint_error = function(e) {
    message("Guardrail triggered: ", conditionMessage(e))
  }
)
#> Guardrail triggered: Checkpoint schema mismatch: cannot resume into a different extraction
#> schema.
#> ✖ Checkpoint schema digest:
#>   sha256:ccffa19b89f611e40fc94527c59158080dfa2c0d822a0ffba2d341ecbce83151
#> ✖ Current schema digest:
#>   sha256:1bfa5c739d9a924fa3af797ed463d1c5383e3ae77c47a8cd4eebc5d23d5bf19f
#> ℹ Start a new `checkpoint_path` or pass `resume = FALSE` to overwrite.

Offline Troubleshooting Checklist

  • Proxy Pre-Flight Failure (env_proxy_isolation): On institutional HPC login nodes that export HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY, either unset proxy variables inside your Slurm job script (unset HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY) or explicitly include NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost.
  • Legacy Clinical CSV Encoding Errors: airgapllm automatically normalizes Windows-1252 smart quotes and Latin-1 characters to valid UTF-8 prior to PII scanning and JSON serialization.
  • Symlinked Scratch Directories: verify_model_digest() blocks symlinks escaping model_dir by default (allow_symlinks = FALSE); store canonical weight files directly inside the bound model directory.
